Jasper is the leading AI marketing platform, enabling the world's most innovative companies to reimagine their end-to-end marketing workflows and drive higher ROI through increased brand consistency, efficiency, and personalization at scale.
Jasper has been recognized as "one of the Top 15 Most Innovative AI Companies of 2024" by Fast Company and is trusted by nearly 20% of the Fortune 500 – including Prudential, Ulta Beauty, and Wayfair. Founded in 2021, Jasper is a remote-first organization with team members across the US, France, and Australia.

As the Executive Assistant to the CEO , you will be a trusted strategic partner and force multiplier for our CEO, helping him operate at his highest level of impact. This role demands exceptional organizational skills, strong communication abilities, and the utmost discretion in handling confidential information.

Alongside this strategic remit, you'll also manage the CEO's schedule, travel, meeting materials, and other administrative essentials — with the same precision and attention to detail.

This role demands exceptional judgment, strong communication abilities across all levels of the organization, and the utmost discretion in handling confidential information.
This role reports to the Senior Manager, Executive Operations, and works in close daily partnership with the CEO. The role is open to candidates located in the UK, with a strong preference for someone based in London. While this is a fully remote role, there may be times when meeting the CEO and various partners in our London office is necessary, so flexibility to work out of this office is required.

s.h: What You Will Do At Jasper
s.t:
Manage the CEO’s schedule to arrange meetings, triage incoming requests, and ensure that all deadlines are met effectively.
Coordinate and facilitate communication between the executive and other internal team members, ensuring clear and effective collaboration.
Support the Executive Team working cadence including weekly meetings, regular brainstorming sessions and quarterly offsites.
Own travel arrangements and external engagement logistics with meticulous attention to detail, building contingency plans so nothing is left to chance.
Assist with key priorities including preparing necessary materials and organizing the CEO’s workflow.
Proactively identify issues and implement solutions to maintain momentum on critical activities.
Prepare materials and organize workflow to keep the CEO's key priorities moving forward.
Partner closely with the Senior Manager, Executive Operations and cross-functional leaders to strengthen and continuously improve executive operations processes.
Support the CEO's engagement with the Board and other senior stakeholders, including helping prepare materials and coordinate logistics for Board meetings and other high-stakes, elevated communications.
What You Will Bring To Jasper
7+ years of experience as an executive assistant or in a similar administrative role, ideally supporting C-level executives — with 2-4+ years directly supporting a CEO or Founder strongly preferred.
Exceptional organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with comfort communicating at the Board and executive level.
Sound independent judgment and decision-making — able to distinguish between what to run with and what to escalate.
Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with the highest level of discretion.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and autonomously.
Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build positive relationships with colleagues and external contacts.
Flexibility and adaptability in a fast-paced and dynamic work environment.

At Jasper, we believe in pay transparency and are committed to providing our employees and candidates with access to information about our compensation practices. The expected base salary range offered for this role is £85,000 - £100,000. Compensation may vary based on relevant experience, skills, competencies, and certifications.

Zirtual is a work-life balanced company that provides clients with experienced, highly skilled remote assistants for both personal and professional needs. Our Executive Assistants are committed to delivering efficient, proactive, and high-quality support that meets and exceeds client expectations.
The Executive Assistant is a vital member of the Zirtual team and serves as the primary point of contact for assigned clients. In this role, you will work independently while receiving support from an Account Supervisor, who will assist with client relationships, plan adjustments, quality feedback, and ongoing guidance.
As an Executive Assistant, you will play a critical role in supporting busy professionals by managing schedules, communications, and day-to-day operations. You will help streamline workflows, anticipate needs, and ensure tasks are completed efficiently and accurately.
Assistants are expected to be available for clients during business hours as agreed upon with each client but around-the-clock availability is not expected. Responsibilities also include sending weekly usage reports, responding to communication within a two-hour window, maintaining detailed client profiles, and following Zirtual's best practices for success.
This role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Typical Duties and Responsibilities (may vary based on client needs)
Calendar & Schedule Management
Manage and coordinate complex calendars and appointments
Schedule meetings, calls, and events across multiple time zones
Anticipate scheduling conflicts and proactively resolve them
Email & Communication Management
Monitor and manage inboxes, including drafting and responding to emails
Prioritize communications and ensure timely follow-up
Serve as a liaison between clients and internal/external contacts
Administrative Support
Prepare documents, presentations, and reports
Handle data entry, file organization, and record maintenance
Assist with project coordination and task tracking
Travel & Event Coordination
Research and book travel arrangements (flights, hotels, transportation)
Create detailed itineraries and manage travel changes
Coordinate virtual and in-person meetings or events
Operations & Task Management
Support day-to-day business operations
Conduct research and compile information as needed
Identify opportunities to improve processes and efficiency

Skills & Attributes
Strong organizational and time management skills
Excellent written and verbal communication
High attention to detail and accuracy
Ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines
Proactive, resourceful, and solution-oriented mindset
Ability to work independently in a remote environment

Bilingual (English/French and/or Spanish)
Experience supporting executives, entrepreneurs, or small business owners

Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business Administration or related field (or equivalent experience)
2-4+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, or similar role

s.t:

Technical Skills
Google Workspace and/or Microsoft Office

Communication tools (Slack, Zoom, Teams)

Reliable high-speed internet, computer, and phone
Ability to maintain confidentiality and professionalism
Availability during business hours (PST or EST, Monday-Friday), unless otherwise agreed in writing with each client
This independent contractor opportunity is currently available only to individuals residing in the United States or Canada.

This is an independent contractor position. Compensation is based on a percentage of client monthly plans, with average monthly earnings ranging from $1,500-$3,800, depending on client mix.
Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams
Zirtual is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Zirtual representatives and offer job seekers false interviews or job offers. These scams often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.
To help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following points in mind:
No Financial Requests: Zirtual will never ask for payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates
No Equipment: Zirtual does not provide equipment and does not request candidates to pay for equipment

Direct from Zirtual: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @zirtual.com address
Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @zirtual.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Zirtual, please report it immediately to support@zirtual.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts

This is a full-time role based out of our SF Hub.

Support the Chief People Officer and VP, Talent with calendar, travel, meetings, agendas, preparation, tasks, notes, emails.
Serve as a strategic thought and execution partner to your Executives and their leadership teams, with a focus on team cohesion, operations, and planning.
Identify areas to optimize the Executives’ time and make recommendations regarding time management, prioritization, and business needs.
Partner with internal teams to ensure cross functional alignment on projects, company milestones, and internal events – this will include some ad hoc project management
Act as a delegate for your Executives by signing off on expenses, approving POs, and managing other tooling as needed, with careful attention to internal policy.
Find opportunities for process optimization across team and company workflows.
Prepare and/or build content, presentations, and key documents for your leaders
Partner cross-functionally with the People Team and other internal teams to ensure alignment on projects, company milestones, and internal events.

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Office Manager plays a critical role in delivering a seamless and welcoming office experience by coordinating daily office operations, supporting local leaders and employees, and ensuring the office is prepared to enable great work, connection, and gathering.
This role partners closely with the country manager and several teams to ensure the office remains an effective, connected, and highly functional workplace. This role serves as a key coordinator across many teams including: Workplace Operations, vendors, Gathering, Security, IT, Office of the CEO, Mission Control and Employee Experience.

The Office Manager helps ensure the office is consistently ready to welcome employees, leaders, guests, and visitors while supporting the experiences that bring Airbnb's culture to life.
This role combines strong operational execution, hospitality, organization, and administrative coordination to create an environment where employees feel supported and connected.
This role reports to the Country Manager and has dotted line accountability to the Regional Workplace Operations and Gathering Teams and will join team meetings.

As an Office Manager, you help bring Airbnb's culture to life through exceptional execution and service.
You will coordinate daily office operations, support local leaders, facilitate gatherings and leadership visits, and serve as a trusted resource for employees and visitors. Through strong organization, hospitality, and attention to detail, you help create an office experience that feels welcoming, seamless, and connected.
Success in this role requires excellent judgment, strong relationship-building skills, operational rigor, and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues before they impact the employee experience.

Support the Office Experience
Help ensure the office is welcoming, organized, and operationally ready each day.
Serve as a visible and approachable presence for employees, visitors, and guests.
Support day-to-day workplace experience programs and services.
Monitor office needs and proactively address issues or escalate to global and regional counterparts as needed.
Help maintain hospitality standards across office spaces, meeting rooms, and shared environments.
Coordinate Office Operations
Support the daily coordination of workplace operations, hospitality services, food programs, and office amenities.
Partner with vendors and service providers to ensure consistent delivery of services and timely issue resolution.
Monitor workplace conditions and employee feedback.
Track office requests, operational issues, and follow-up actions.
Identify opportunities for improvement and communicate recommendations to regional leader and global ops team.
Maintain office documentation, communications, and operational processes.
Support implementation of office standards and playbooks.
Support office utilization reporting.
Leadership & Administrative Support
Serve as a trusted admin partner to the Country Manager.
Provide calendar booking support, meeting coordination and room scheduling support for the Country Manager.
Partner with executive administrative partners to coordinate logistics for leadership visits, executive meetings, and business gatherings.
Serve as a local resource for employees and leaders navigating office services and resources.
This role is not responsible for travel booking, expense management. This role only supports Country Manager diary/calendar support.
Support Gatherings & Connection
Coordinate logistics for local gatherings, leadership visits, and employee engagement activities.
Support gatherings, leadership visits and employee engagement activities across the region as needed.
Partner with the Workplace Operations team and Regional Gathering Manager to support successful delivery of events and connection moments.
Ensure meeting spaces, hospitality elements, vendors, and attendee experiences are prepared and executed effectively.
Support the delivery of connection and community-building experiences within the office by following global guidance and toolkits, while adapting them to local needs.
Build Strong Relationships
Develop positive working relationships with employees, leaders, Executive Assistants, vendors, and cross-functional partners.
Support a culture of hospitality, responsiveness, and service.
Gather employee feedback and share insights to improve the office experience.
Help foster an environment where employees feel welcomed, informed, and connected.

5+ years of experience in office management, workplace experience, hospitality, events, administration, employee experience, or related fields.
Strong organizational and project coordination skills.
Experience coordinating meetings, events, leadership visits, or workplace programs.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong attention to detail and follow-through.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Hospitality mindset with a passion for creating positive experiences.
Strong problem-solving skills and sound judgment.
Experience partnering with vendors and cross-functional stakeholders is preferred.
Full professional proficiency in English and German.
This position needs to be based in the Berlin office 5 days a week.

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

s.h: How We'll Take Care of You
s.t: Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Office Manager plays a critical role in delivering a seamless and welcoming office experience by coordinating daily office operations, supporting local leaders and employees, and ensuring the office is prepared to enable great work, connection, and gathering.

This role partners closely with the country manager and several teams to ensure the office remains an effective, connected, and highly functional workplace. This role serves as a key coordinator across many teams including: Workplace Operations, vendors, Gathering, Security, IT, Office of the CEO, Mission Control and Employee Experience.

The Office Manager helps ensure the office is consistently ready to welcome employees, leaders, guests, and visitors while supporting the experiences that bring Airbnb's culture to life.

This role combines strong operational execution, hospitality, organization, and administrative coordination to create an environment where employees feel supported and connected.

This role reports to the Country Manager and has dotted line accountability to the Regional Workplace Operations and Gathering Teams and will join team meetings.

As an Office Manager, you help bring Airbnb's culture to life through exceptional execution and service.

You will coordinate daily office operations, support local leaders, facilitate gatherings and leadership visits, and serve as a trusted resource for employees and visitors. Through strong organization, hospitality, and attention to detail, you help create an office experience that feels welcoming, seamless, and connected.

Success in this role requires excellent judgment, strong relationship-building skills, operational rigor, and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues before they impact the employee experience.

Support the Office Experience

· Help ensure the office is welcoming, organized, and operationally ready each day.

· Serve as a visible and approachable presence for employees, visitors, and guests.

· Support day-to-day workplace experience programs and services.

· Monitor office needs and proactively address issues or escalate to global and regional counterparts as needed.

· Help maintain hospitality standards across office spaces, meeting rooms, and shared environments.

Coordinate Office Operations

· Support the daily coordination of workplace operations, hospitality services, food programs, and office amenities.

· Partner with vendors and service providers to ensure consistent delivery of services and timely issue resolution.

· Monitor workplace conditions and employee feedback.

· Track office requests, operational issues, and follow-up actions.

· Identify opportunities for improvement and communicate recommendations to regional leader and global ops team.

· Maintain office documentation, communications, and operational processes.

· Support implementation of office standards and playbooks.

· Support office utilization reporting.

Leadership & Administrative Support

· Serve as a trusted admin partner to the Country Manager.

· Provide calendar booking support, meeting coordination and room scheduling support for the Country Manager.

· Partner with executive administrative partners to coordinate logistics for leadership visits, executive meetings, and business gatherings.

· Serve as a local resource for employees and leaders navigating office services and resources.

This role is not responsible for travel booking, expense management. This role only supports Country Manager diary/calendar support.

Support Gatherings & Connection

· Coordinate logistics for local gatherings, leadership visits, and employee engagement activities.

· Support gatherings, leadership visits and employee engagement activities across the region as needed.

· Partner with the Workplace Operations team and Regional Gathering Manager to support successful delivery of events and connection moments.

· Ensure meeting spaces, hospitality elements, vendors, and attendee experiences are prepared and executed effectively.

· Support the delivery of connection and community-building experiences within the office by following global guidance and toolkits, while adapting them to local needs.

Build Strong Relationships

· Develop positive working relationships with employees, leaders, Executive Assistants, vendors, and cross-functional partners.

· Support a culture of hospitality, responsiveness, and service.

· Gather employee feedback and share insights to improve the office experience.

· Help foster an environment where employees feel welcomed, informed, and connected.

· 5+ years of experience in office management, workplace experience, hospitality, events, administration, employee experience, or related fields.

· Strong organizational and project coordination skills.

· Experience coordinating meetings, events, leadership visits, or workplace programs.

· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

· Strong attention to detail and follow-through.

· Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

· Hospitality mindset with a passion for creating positive experiences.

· Strong problem-solving skills and sound judgment.

· Experience partnering with vendors and cross-functional stakeholders is preferred.

· Full professional proficiency in English.
This position needs to be based in the London office 5 days a week.

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

Databricks is looking for a highly capable, process-driven, and proactive Executive Assistant to support a Senior Leader within Product & Engineering, while also supporting our SVP of Corporate Development & Ventures.

The primary mission of this person is to support our Engineering and Product leaders, partnering with them to operationalize their teams' cross-functional strategies. You will serve as a key liaison across various departments—including Sales, Marketing, IT, and other critical functions—to ensure alignment and execution. Additionally, you will drive strategic initiatives and community events that foster collaboration across the Engineering and Product organizations.

While deeply rooted in supporting a massive internal engineering footprint, this high-visibility, fast-paced role sits at a unique intersection. · Provide timely responses to all stakeholder requests.

· Enhance the Engineering leader's time efficiency, leading to a more productive team and company.

· Confidentiality & Discretion: Handles sensitive, non-public information—including product roadmaps, M&A targets, term sheets, and board-level matters—with the judgment and professionalism appropriate to that trust.

· Team Coverage: May be required to support other executive staff members if there's a coverage gap due to PTO, sickness, maternity leave, or other absences.

· Minimum of 7+ years of applicable executive administrative experience, ideally from a global software organization.

· Proven track record working with VPs/SVPs in Engineering and Product in large organizations.

· Experience working with VPs managing over 2000+ people in engineering, customer-facing, and/or technical roles.

· Ability to work at a fast pace with shifting priorities in a hyper-scaling, high-growth company, with experience directly supporting an executive staff member.

· High attention to detail , organization, and process abilities; structured thinking with an operational mindset that can bring order to chaos.

· Strong calendaring skills (Gmail and Google Calendar experience mandatory).

· Strong relationship management skills and the ability to build a personal network throughout the company; you earn trust quickly and know how to work through organizational complexity.

· Strong teamwork skills , and a confident ability to offer suggestions and improvements to the process, and work very collaboratively with others.

· Strong oral and written communication with the ability to communicate clearly and effectively with senior leaders, developers, and external partners.

· Technology Fluency: A genuine curiosity about technology, high-growth companies, and the AI/data landscape. Comfortable dealing with engineers, technical leaders, and opinionated entrepreneurs.

Why This Role

You'll work alongside the core engine of Databricks and one of the most active corporate development teams in enterprise tech. At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.
With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.
Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement.

We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.
About the Workplace & Real Estate Team
The Workplace & Real Estate team builds the places where LangChain builds the future of AI agents. Our job is to make every office somewhere people want to be, spaces that run flawlessly, feel great to walk into, and reflect the craft bar of the company in every detail.

We treat the workplace as a product: designed with intent, measured, and continuously improved. We run a small, high-agency team of on-site owners in each hub, and we automate the manual work rather than adding it, across two master-lease hubs (SF, NY) and coworking spokes as the company scales.

The Office Manager owns our SF HQ end-to-end, both the on-the-ground experience and the systems that make it run. SF is our largest hub and headquarters, and we regularly host company and team offsites.

You open and reset the space first thing every morning and are the face of the office through the day, and you build the tooling, standards, and vendor programs that keep it running consistently as we scale. This is a hands-on role for a builder who takes pride in a flawless space and in the systems behind it.
Location: This role is based on-site in our San Francisco (HQ) office, five days per week.

Own the space & the craft bar
Open and reset the space first thing every morning, before people arrive, the office is clean, stocked, and ready
Keep the space super organized, neat, tidy, clean, and stocked at all times; it should always be on point and represent the quality of the company
Run a regular walkthrough punch list and stay on top of the details
Be the face of the office
Present through business hours as front-of-house: greet guests, welcome and guide new hires and visitors, and be the person people find

¿Quieres cambiar el mundo? Eso es lo que hacemos en Cabify. Nuestro objetivo es hacer de las ciudades mejores lugares para vivir, mejorando la movilidad de las personas que viven en ellas, conectando a pasajeros y conductores con tan sólo pulsar un botón. Es posible que algún día las ciudades sean lugares donde nadie necesite un auto privado, pero aún nos queda un largo camino por recorrer… ¿nos acompañas?
Fundada en 2011, nos hemos convertido en el primer ‘unicornio’ español. Nuestra sede central está en Madrid pero actualmente nos encontramos en 42 ciudades de España y Latinoamérica.

Y cada mes que pasa más gente se une a nuestro equipo internacional lleno de personas apasionadas, brillantes y con talento con ganas de desafiar el “status quo”.Pero no importa lo rápido que crezcamos o lo grande que nos volvamos, queremos mantener nuestro espíritu ‘start-up’.

Somos un equipo seguro de sí mismo, energético, profesional y carismático, y estamos orgullosos de hacer las cosas bien.

Nos gusta pensar en nosotros mismos como una empresa de tecnología ética e innovadora que ha creado un negocio donde todos son tratados de manera justa y respetuosa, desde nuestros ingenieros hasta los conductores que utilizan nuestra plataforma.

Además, siempre cumplimos plenamente con las regulaciones gubernamentales y respetamos las leyes locales. Hemos recorrido un largo camino hasta ahora, pero en realidad nuestro viaje no ha hecho más que comenzar. Si vamos a convertir nuestra misión en una realidad, ¡necesitamos que personas con talento y ambición como tú se unan a nuestro equipo!

Joining Collibra’s Office of the CEO team
Collibra is seeking an experienced Executive Assistant to support our Chief Executive Officer. In this role, you'll be responsible for managing the day-to-day logistics that keep our CEO operating efficiently, from complex calendar management and global travel to meeting coordination and administrative support.
The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and thrives on staying one step ahead. You'll anticipate needs, solve problems before they arise, and ensure every detail is handled with care.

You'll work closely with leaders and partner with colleagues across the business to make the best use of his time, enabling him to stay focused on leading the company. While your primary responsibility will be supporting the CEO, you'll also provide support to other senior leaders as business needs require.

You'll operate as part of the management Office, partnering daily with the NYC-based Operations & Events Lead.
While you own the day-to-day logistics of scheduling execution, executive briefings, client meeting tracking, travel, expenses, and Brussels-based coordination, the central team owns strategic calendar oversight and ExCom operations. This partnership ensures seamless coverage across time zones and that our leadership has coverage across our two main offices: Brussels & New York.
This is a hybrid role based in our Brussels office. Our hybrid model means you'll work from the office at least four days each week. This role also requires some evening overlap with US East Coast working hours along with occasional early morning meetings across EMEA time zones.
Executive Assistants at Collibra are responsible for
Providing comprehensive administrative support to the CEO with the highest level of discretion, anticipating needs before they arise and ensuring every meeting is confirmed, prepped, and logistically sound.
Monitoring incoming communications and requests for the CEO's time, proactively resolving conflicts and exercising sound judgment to balance competing priorities and keep the CEO focused on what matters most.
Coordinating all aspects of domestic and international travel including flights, hotels, ground transportation, visas, and detailed itineraries, while managing procurement, vendor, and expense approval workflows via Zip and Navan and reconciling the CEO's expenses, ensuring nothing bottlenecks.
Supporting the planning and execution of leadership meetings, offsites, and executive events in close partnership with the NYC-based CEO Operations and Events Lead, staying several steps ahead to ensure seamless coverage across Brussels and New York.
Acting as the connective tissue across the business by building strong relationships, facilitating communication, coordinating legal document execution, and gathering EMEA-side context to support client visit briefs.
Welcoming visitors and coordinating executive meetings in the Brussels office, while providing administrative support to other senior leaders and handling occasional personal requests with professionalism and care.
You have
8–10 years of experience supporting senior executives, including experience supporting a C-suite executive.
Extensive experience managing complex calendars, international travel, and executive scheduling across multiple time zones.
Exceptional organizational and time management skills, with the ability to anticipate needs and stay several steps ahead.
Strong written and verbal communication skills and a warm, professional, customer-focused approach.
Excellent judgment and the ability to handle highly confidential information with complete discretion, including regular exposure to Board-level materials and sensitive company information..
Advanced proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office, particularly Google Calendar, Google Sheets, Google Slides, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Experience with modern executive operations tooling; Navan, Zip (or comparable travel and procurement platforms), DocuSign, Slack, and Zoom.
Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Copilot) to solve real-world business challenges, drive measurable outcomes, or streamline workflows.
Experience managing expenses, budgets, and administrative processes.
Experience working in a SaaS or enterprise software environment is preferred.
A bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
You are
Highly organized, proactive, and dependable.
Calm under pressure and able to manage multiple competing priorities with confidence.
An exceptional planner who enjoys creating order and solving logistical challenges.
Detail-oriented without losing sight of the bigger picture.
Able to anticipate needs and adapt quickly as priorities change.
Comfortable working independently while building strong relationships across the organization.
Willing to roll up your sleeves—no task is too small.
Trusted to handle sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and sound judgment.

Rocket Lab is an end-to-end space company delivering responsive launch services, complete spacecraft design and manufacturing, payloads, satellite components, and more – all with the goal of opening access to space. The rockets and satellites we build and launch enable some of the most ambitious and vital space missions globally, supporting scientific exploration, Earth observation and missions to combat climate change, national security, and exciting new technology demonstrations.

Our Electron rocket has become the second most frequently launched U.S. rocket annually and has delivered more than 230 satellites to orbit, all while we work to develop Neutron, our upcoming medium-lift, reusable launch vehicle for larger constellation deployment.

Our Space Systems business designs and builds our extensive line of satellites, payloads, and their components, including spacecraft that have been selected to support NASA missions to the Moon and Mars and components used on the James Webb Space Telescope.

Based on site at Rocket Lab's headquarters in Long Beach, California the Executive Assistant is responsible for complex calendar management and scheduling of internal and external meetings across multiple time zones, handling expenses, multi-tasking during ad hoc projects, preparing for meetings, assisting with presentations and a variety of other day-to-day administrative tasks.

· Manage executive calendars and schedules

· Organize and execute logistics for meetings, conferences, and off-site events, including playing a key role in preparing for Board meetings, investor presentations, and critical business and executive events

· Document and distribute meeting minutes and action items

· Greet guests and assist with special projects relating to guest/visitors

· Other duties as assigned

· Associate's degree

In alignment with Amplitude's hybrid workplace philosophy, this role is based in our San Francisco headquarters and is expected to work onsite multiple days each week. We believe in-person collaboration strengthens relationships, accelerates decision-making, and creates meaningful opportunities to partner closely with our executives and cross-functional teams while still providing flexibility when appropriate.

s.t:
Partner closely with the CHRO and Head of Marketing to proactively manage complex calendars, competing priorities, communications, travel, and day-to-day executive operations.
Drive execution of key business rhythms—including staff meetings, leadership reviews, team offsites, All Hands, QBRs, and cross-functional planning—ensuring seamless logistics and follow-through.
Build strong relationships across the executive team and partner with Workplace, Employee Experience, Finance, Recruiting, and other cross-functional teams to keep priorities moving efficiently.
Handle highly confidential information with exceptional judgment while serving as a trusted advisor and thought partner to both executives.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve processes, leverage AI and automation tools where appropriate, and create scalable ways of working that increase executive effectiveness.

You have exceptional attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and take pride in delivering a polished, high-quality experience.
You embrace new technologies, including AI-powered productivity tools, and are always looking for smarter ways to work.

Experience managing complex domestic and international travel, executive calendars, meeting logistics, expense reporting, and executive communications.
Advanced proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Docs, Slides, Sheets) and experience creating executive-ready presentations and documents.
Demonstrated ability to manage highly confidential information with professionalism, integrity, and discretion.

s.h: BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
s.t:
At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.

Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you .

We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you.

At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.

This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. A propos de Bull
Bull c’est une histoire. Un siècle d’innovation Européenne et un environnement de travail où des experts conçoivent des solutions numériques puissantes, durables et souveraines, permettant aux États et aux industries de garder la pleine maîtrise de leurs données et de leur IA.
Bull c’est aussi des milliers d’ingénieurs, de chercheurs, de passionnés de tech, façonnant l’avenir du calcul de haute performance, de l’IA et des technologies quantiques.
Chaque jour, nos équipes repoussent les limites du possible - des architectures HPC de nouvelle génération aux supercalculateurs exascale - soutenues par une R&D de rang mondial, plus de 1 600 brevets et des capacités de bout en bout uniques, couvrant la conception matérielle, l’ingénierie logicielle, la data science et la recherche quantique.
Centrés sur l’humain et portés par l’innovation, où la collaboration s’étend à l’Europe, aux Amériques et à l’Inde, nous partageons cette même vision d’une innovation responsable et durable, avec un impact concret pour nos clients.

Contexte
Chez BULL, nous concevons et déployons des systèmes informatiques à haute performance, d'intelligence artificielle et des technologies critiques au service des infrastructures stratégiques. En tant que leader européen indépendant, BULL se positionne à la pointe de l'innovation et de l'excellence industrielle.
Dans le cadre du remplacement d'un départ en retraite au sein de la R&D, le poste est maintenu et rattaché à la Business Unit ECN. Il s'inscrit dans un périmètre transversal et mutualisé entre nos activités ECN et nos équipes R&D.
En tant qu' Executive Assistant , vous intervenez au cœur du leadership exécutif. Véritable partenaire de confiance, vous apportez un support organisationnel et opérationnel de haut niveau visant à garantir l'alignement stratégique, la fluidité des opérations et l'efficacité de la prise de décision.
Responsabilités principales
Vos Missions S'articulent Autour De La Gestion Des Priorités Exécutives, Du Suivi De La Gouvernance Et De La Performance Opérationnelle
Pilotage de l'agenda et organisation exécutive
Orchestrer, optimiser et arbitrer l'agenda ainsi que le rythme exécutif de la direction dans un environnement complexe et très réactif.
Planifier et coordonner les instances de gouvernance, réunions de direction et événements exécutifs.
Organiser les déplacements complexes (nationaux et internationaux).
Préparation des livrables et suivi des décisions
Préparer et consolider les supports stratégiques (dossiers, notes de cadrage, présentations de niveau direction, synthèses).
Assurer le suivi rigoureux ( follow-up ) des décisions clés, des plans d'action et des initiatives de transformation.
Suivre les indicateurs de performance (KPIs) et dashboards de la direction.
Communication, synthèse et interface stratégique
Rédiger des communications et comptes-rendus à fort niveau d'exigence et de synthèse.
Assurer l'interface privilégiée et fluide entre la direction, les lignes d'affaires ECN, la R&D et les parties prenantes externes de haut niveau.
Traiter la correspondance, le filtrage des sollicitations et garantir la stricte confidentialité des dossiers confiés.

Formation & Expérience : Vous justifiez d'au moins 8 ans d'expérience dans des fonctions de support exécutif (Executive Assistant, Executive Business Partner) ou de gestion d'entreprise auprès de dirigeants. Expérience confirmée au sein d'organisations internationales , matricielles et à fort rythme.
Requis
Solide culture d'entreprise et compréhension fine des enjeux et priorités stratégiques d'une direction générale.
Excellente maîtrise de la suite Microsoft 365 et des outils de collaboration exécutive.
Capacités rédactionnelles, de communication et d'esprit de synthèse de haut niveau.
Bilinguisme parfait en Français et Anglais (usage quotidien à l'oral comme à l'écrit avec des interlocuteurs internationaux).
Optionnel
Expérience préalable au sein d'un environnement R&D, hautement technologique ou industriel.
Expérience réussie sur un poste en support partagé/transversal entre plusieurs entités ou Business Units.
Soft Skills
Posture de partenaire de confiance, sens élevé de la responsabilité et présence exécutive.
Forte capacité d'anticipation, de priorisation et d'autonomie dans la gestion de l'ambiguïté.
Rigueur, diplomatie, aisance relationnelle et discrétion absolue.
Pourquoi postuler ?
Ce poste offre une exposition directe aux prises de décision stratégiques au sein d'un leader européen de la technologie. Vous jouerez un rôle de bras droit exécutif à fort impact sur la performance opérationnelle des entités ECN et R&D, au sein d'un environnement stimulant.
Pourquoi ne pas postuler ?
Si vous recherchez un poste d'assistanat classique sans exposition aux enjeux stratégiques et sans proximité directe avec un niveau de direction générale (EVP).
Si vous privilégiez un environnement de travail strictement local et n'avez pas l'habitude des contextes internationaux bilingues.
Si vous n'avez pas encore l'autonomie nécessaire pour piloter en toute indépendance des dossiers transversaux complexes et arbitrer des priorités mouvantes.

Manage the CEO’s calendar: schedule and reschedule meetings, protect focused work time, and make sure the right things happen at the right time.
Know the CEO’s schedule well enough to coordinate on his behalf — which days he doesn’t take meetings, when he’s traveling, what’s happening before or after a commitment so time doesn’t get booked incorrectly.
Book meetings and coordinate with internal and external stakeholders directly, representing the CEO’s preferences clearly and professionally.
Coordinate executive team meetings, management reviews, and board meetings, including logistics and follow-up.
Handle travel planning end-to-end: flights, hotels, ground transport, itineraries, and any changes along the way.
Take care of personal tasks and errands as needed — this is a role where no task is beneath you and being helpful is the job.
Support ad hoc projects as they come up, with minimal direction and good follow-through.

Reliable above all else: when you say you’ll do something, it gets done. No reminders needed.
Discreet: you will be close to sensitive information, and you treat that with the seriousness it deserves.
A quick learner: you pick things up fast, ask good questions, and don’t make the same mistake twice.
Calm and organized under pressure: when plans change — and they will — you adapt without drama.

We’re looking for an experienced, full-time Executive Assistant to join our team in Berlin and support our Co-CEOs, Lennard and Judith.
In this role, you’ll work closely with our Co-CEOs, Lennard and Judith, as part of a young, entrepreneurial team. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, love bringing order to hectic schedules, and approach each day with a proactive mindset, we’d love to meet you.
We’re looking for someone highly organized, calm, self-motivated, and adaptable.

Internal organisation and steering. You run the CEO's operating rhythm. Calendar, inbox triage, meeting preparation, and follow-through all sit with you. You keep an eye on details and you keep the leadership cadence (weeklies, board preparation, offsites) moving.
External travel and speaking. You plan and book complex international travel end to end, and you manage the speaking pipeline: inbound requests, selection, briefing packs, and logistics on the ground.
C-level relationship management. You become the trusted point of contact for the CEO's most important external relationships: customers, partners, and investors. You track who needs a touchpoint and when, and protect these relationships through reliability and proactivity.
Augmentation and anticipation. You work half a step ahead of everyone else in the room. You can identify a bottleneck before it forms. You build the systems, defaults and briefings that let the CEO spend their time on judgement rather than logistics.
Admin. You manage expenses and finance admin and can support with occasional personal assistant (PA) duties as needed.
CEO office collaboration. You’ll work in very close coordination with the CEO office, which includes a Chief of Staff and CEO Office Manager who are responsible for operational processes in the CEO office. Incl. performance management, KPI tracking, leadership accountability and strategic projects.
You Might Be a Fit If…
You have previously supported a CEO or equivalent in a demanding organisation and are looking for another environment that gives you an opportunity to grow.
You want to be in a young, fast company. You are comfortable with ambiguity, short timelines and a team that is still writing its own playbook, and you would rather shape the system than inherit a finished one.
You are mission-driven. You care that European companies build and adopt AI, and you want your work to count toward that rather than toward a job title. You are eager to automate your own work where possible.
AI can do a lot of things, but in the short term, it won't be able to shepherd a growing group of mostly young people in a very dynamic environment. We are looking for someone who can foster the most important human qualities within the organization.
We are looking for a long-term partner, not someone optimizing for their next role.
Personified calmness – You bring order, not chaos. When things get hectic, you're the person who slows down, thinks clearly, and helps others do the same. Your presence makes people feel like things are under control. You instill calmness and continuity in the organization.
Good judgment – You know what matters and what doesn't. You read people well. You understand when to push and when to give space, when something is urgent and when it can wait.
Compassionate and empathetic – You care about the people around you. You understand that behind every missed deadline or dropped ball is a human with hidden context. You hold people accountable with kindness.
Ownership mentality – You see problems and fix them without being asked. You don't wait for permission. You follow through.
Strong communicator – Written and verbal. You can draft important emails or have a difficult conversation with equal skill.
Trustworthy – You'll have access to everything and work directly with the CEO. Discretion and trust are very important.
You are a kind person who cares about the people around you.
The Environment
We work from our office in Berlin, Greifswalder Strasse 212. Everyone works together in person because the hardest problems get solved faster at a whiteboard than in a Slack thread. Conversations happen faster, problems get solved quicker, and we actually know each other.
Days start at 8:30. Lunch & dinner are together. We run, go to the gym, and take care of ourselves. Health is not separate from work here, it is part of how we work well.
The vibe is calm but intense. No one is yelling or panicking. But everyone is working hard on things that matter.

Salaries are transparent and tied to levels, not negotiation. All roles include equity.
We will figure out the right level together based on your experience and scope. Levels are about the work you own, not your title or years of experience. We narrow down the expected salary range early in the process.
Next steps
We move fast. Most processes complete within two weeks.

## Description du poste ##
En qualité de coordinateur ou coordinatrice gestion des locaux, vous assurez la coordination des demandes liées à l'attribution des locaux, aux aménagements des espaces de travail ainsi qu'aux déménagements des activités et des collaborateurs et collaboratrices au sein des HUG.
Interlocuteur ou interlocutrice privilégiée du personnel, vous analysez les besoins exprimés et veillez à leur cohérence avec la stratégie immobilière institutionnelle ainsi qu'avec le schéma directeur des HUG.
Vous évaluez les demandes, proposez des solutions adaptées et recherchez des alternatives permettant une utilisation efficiente des surfaces et des ressources mises à disposition.

Vous assurez également la gestion et la mise à jour de la signalétique de proximité en collaboration avec la Direction de la communication, tout en veillant au respect de la charte graphique institutionnelle.

Vous maîtrisez les outils bureautiques usuels. Une expérience sur des logiciels de dessin ou de gestion des espaces constitue un atout.
Vous avez un excellent sens du service, vous faites preuve d'autonomie, de rigueur et d'organisation dans la conduite de vos activités.
Votre aisance relationnelle, votre capacité à coordonner et votre aptitude à accompagner le changement vous permettent d'évoluer efficacement dans un environnement hospitalier en constante évolution.

# Coordinator of the CAS in Quantum Science at D-PHYS, ETH Zurich #
#### 60%, Zurich, fixed-term ####
print Drucken
The Department of Physics (D-PHYS) at ETH Zurich pursues a diverse research agenda and a broad teaching program. These encompass diverse areas of physics, ranging from the fundamental principles of nature to innovative technologies for society. The Institute of Theoretical Physics (https://itp.phys.ethz.ch/), D-PHYS, ETH Zurich is seeking to hire a Coordinator who will lead the new continuing education program in quantum science. The appointment is expected for a 60 % full-time equivalent.
## Project background ##
The Certificate of Advanced Studies (CAS) in Quantum Science at ETH Zurich is designed to provide digital technology experts, engineers, and professionals in banking or government with a strong foundation in quantum science and its emerging applications.

Bringing together expertise from across D-PHYS and the ETH Quantum Center, the programme combines high-level academic teaching with insights into foundations and current developments in quantum technologies.

The CAS Coordinator will play a central role in the development, launch, and implementation of the programme and will serve as the key interface between the CAS directors, participants, lecturers, the ETH School for Continuing Education (SCE), and other internal and external partners.
## Job description ##
As the Coordinator of CAS in Quantum Science, you will oversee and contribute to the development, launch, and implementation of the CAS in Quantum Science.

You will work closely with the CAS directors, D-PHYS professors and study administration, ITP administration and act as the central point of contact for the ETH SCE, as well as with other relevant units at ETH Zurich, including the ETH Quantum Center.

Your responsibilities will include coordinating the curriculum and program schedule, supporting the selection and admission of participants, managing communication with participants and lecturers, and overseeing the program-s administration, budget, and implementation.

You will also contribute to the program-s communication and marketing activities, support the recruitment of participants, and serve as the central point of contact for the program.

s.h: You will be responsible for and contribute to
s.t:
* Development, conceptualization and management of the continuing education program (CAS) in Quantum Science and its administration
* Communication and coordination with the lecturers, D-PHYS study secretariat, SCE and the ETH Quantum Center.
* Representation of the CAS and outreach regarding its activities.
* Contacts with internal and external academic and industry parties.
* Coordination of marketing and communication for the program in collaboration with colleagues SCE and D-PHYS.
* Serving as a main contact point for prospective students and organizing the student selection process.
## Profile ##
* Excellent multi-stakeholder project management skills, including the ability to drive and manage different workflows and effectively prioritize your time based on needs, goals and opportunities.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to effectively convey complex concepts to diverse stakeholders.
* Excellent English language skills, both written and verbal. Proficiency in the German language facilitates interactions with German-speaking administration and prospective participants.

## Company Description ##
**Über Syngenta**
Bei Syngenta Crop Protection entwickeln wir wegweisende Lösungen, die die globale Ernährungssicherheit schützen und gleichzeitig eine nachhaltige Landwirtschaft fördern. Als Weltmarktführer mit Hauptsitz in der Schweiz befähigen wir Landwirte mit innovativen Pflanzenschutztechnologien, die gegen die härtesten Herausforderungen der Natur schützen.

Wir verbinden fortschrittliche Wissenschaft mit digitalen Lösungen, um intelligenten Pflanzenschutz zu entwickeln, der Erträge maximiert und gleichzeitig die Umweltbelastung minimiert. Werden Sie Teil unserer Mission, den Pflanzenschutz von der Aussaat bis zur Ernte zu revolutionieren.
Wussten Sie, dass Syngenta den Friendly Working Space Zertifikat hat?
Die Gesundheitsförderung Schweiz anerkennt das Engagement von Syngenta für die Gesundheit und das Wohlbefinden der Mitarbeitenden und zeichnet alle Schweizer Standorte mit dem Label "Friendly Work Space" aus. Bei Syngenta sind die Gesundheit und das Wohlbefinden der Mitarbeitenden der Schlüssel zum Unternehmenserfolg. Lesen SIe hier mehr darüber: https://friendlyworkspace.ch/de/das-label/das-sind-die-label-friendly-work-space-betriebe
## Job Description ##
Bei Syngenta ist es unser Ziel, das kollaborativste und vertrauenswürdigste Team in der Landwirtschaft aufzubauen, das qualitativ hochwertiges Saatgut und innovative Pflanzenschutzlösungen bereitstellt, die den Erfolg der Landwirte verbessern. Zur Unterstützung dieser Mission sucht das Hiring Team von Syngenta eine(n) **Maintenance Coordinator (in)** Onsite in Kaisten, Schweiz.
Der Maintenance Coordinator trägt die Verantwortung für die Bewirtschaftung und Weiterentwicklung des Instandhaltungs-Management-Systems sowie für die Koordination der präventiven und korrektiven Instandhaltungsaktivitäten. Ergänzend dazu übernimmt die Rolle aktiv Aufgaben im Bereich Reliability Engineering - mit dem Ziel, die Anlagenzuverlässigkeit systematisch zu steigern und Programme zur mechanischen Integrität und Anlagensicherheit am Standort umzusetzen.
**Aufgaben:**
**Instandhaltungskoordination**
* Verwendung, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung des Maintenance Management Systems in der SAP-Umgebung (PM-Modul)
* Planung, Koordination und Unterstützung von Instandhaltungsaktivitäten im Normalbetrieb sowie während Abstellphasen
* Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Wartungsplänen in Zusammenarbeit mit dem technischen Personal und Fachspezialisten
* Monitoring der Umsetzung des präventiven Instandhaltungsprogramms zur Sicherstellung der Anlagenverfügbarkeit und Konformität mit gesetzlichen und Syngenta-internen Vorgaben
* Koordination und Unterstützung beim Einsatz von Fremdhandwerkern und Erteilung von Aufträgen an externe Fachfirmen
* Bewirtschaftung des technischen Ersatzteillagers sowie Beschaffung von technischem Material und Dienstleistungen
* Aufbau und Pflege der Equipment- und Anlagenhistorie
* Erstellung von Berichten und Leistungskennzahlen (KPIs) zum Instandhaltungsprogramm
* Erstellen, Ausarbeiten und Aktualisieren von Arbeitsanweisungen und technischer Dokumentation
**Reliability Engineering**
* Unterstützung und Leitung von Initiativen zur mechanischen Integrität der Anlagen
* Unterstützung und Leitung der Implementierung globaler Programme, z. B. Sicherheitskritische Anlagen, Kritikalitätsanalyse und zugehörige FMECA-Analysen
* Weiterentwicklung des Reliability-Programms am Standort, inklusive Zustandsüberwachungsprogramm und daraus abgeleiteter Massnahmen, Auswertung von Resultaten aus Prüfungen und Inspektionen
* Unterstützung und Pflege des Bad Actor-Programms: systematische Erfassung und Bearbeitung von wiederholt störungsanfälligen Anlagen und Komponenten
* Leitung oder Mitarbeit bei Projekten zur Zuverlässigkeitssteigerung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung

* Abgeschlossene Berufslehre in einem technischen Bereich (z. B. Polymechaniker/in, Anlagen- oder Betriebsmechaniker/in, Elektrotechnik o.ä.)
* Technische Weiterbildung, z. B. Techniker HF, Meister oder vergleichbar - von Vorteil
* Sehr gute SAP-Kenntnisse, insbesondere im Modul PM
* Grundkenntnisse in Reliability Engineering-Methoden (FMECA, RCM, RCA, Condition Monitoring) von Vorteil
* Erfahrung im Umgang mit SAP in der Instandhaltung
* Erfahrung in der Instandhaltung von verfahrenstechnischen oder chemischen Produktionsanlagen
* Erfahrung in der Planung und Koordination von Abstellphasen (*Shutdowns*) von Vorteil
* Kenntnisse im Bereich Anlagenzuverlässigkeit und/oder mechanische Integrität von Vorteil
* Selbständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise
* Analytisches Denkvermögen und Fähigkeit zur Priorisierung in einem komplexen Umfeld
* Teamfähigkeit und konstruktive Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Partnern
* Kommunikationsstärke und sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Dienstleistern und Projektpartnern
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (Muttersprache oder gleichwertig); Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil
* Urteilsvermögen: Fähigkeit, in der eigenen Verantwortung fundierte technische Entscheidungen zu treffen

## *Introduction* ##
Pour notre **Secteur de production Ebauches**, nous recherchons un(e) **Coordinateur(trice) parc machines & Fournisseur**** (H/F)** dont la mission principale sera de piloter la performance et la fiabilité du parc machines Precitrame en assurant l-interface entre la Production, les services support, les Achats et les fournisseurs, afin de sécuriser la continuité de production et la résolution efficace des problèmes.
## *Responsabilités* ##
* Coordonner les sujets proritaires liées au parc machines Precitrame
* Représenter le secteur auprès du fournisseur Precitrame et assurer la coordination des échanges
* Assurer une vision globale de l-état du parc, des risques, des priorités et des plans d-action
* Participer aux comités de pilotage réunissant les Achats, le fournisseur, la Production et les services concernés
* Garantir un reporting fiable et régulier à destination des équipes et du management
* Fluidifier la communication entre les différents acteurs internes et externes
* Centraliser et analyser les informations relatives aux machines : disponibilité, arrêts, incidents, interventions et actions en cours
* Préparer, participer et assurer le suivi des comités de pilotage avec les Achats, Precitrame, la Production et les services support
* Représenter les besoins, contraintes et priorités du secteur lors des échanges avec le fournisseur
* Formaliser les décisions, suivre les engagements réciproques et relancer les actions dans le respect des délais
* Élaborer et actualiser les tableaux de bord, indicateurs et reportings liés au parc machines
* Animer les points de suivi internes et veiller à la bonne diffusion de l-information
* Identifier les dysfonctionnements récurrents, contribuer à leur analyse et coordonner les actions correctives
## *Profil* ##
* Formation ou expérience en gestion de projet pluridisciplinaire
* CFC technique, idéalement en polymécanique, mécanique, automatisation ou maintenance industrielle
* Formation supérieure technique appréciée : diplôme de technicien-ne ES ou domaine équivalent
* Expérience confirmée dans un environnement de production industrielle
* Bonne compréhension d-un environnement de production et d-un parc de machines industrielles
* Capacité à coordonner des sujets techniques impliquant plusieurs services et un fournisseur externe
* Aptitude à préparer et animer des réunions, formaliser les décisions et piloter les plans d-action associés
* Capacité à structurer et analyser les informations techniques et opérationnelles
* Maîtrise des outils bureautiques, notamment Excel, et aptitude à créer des tableaux de bord
* Rigueur, organisation et fiabilité dans le suivi des engagements
* Sens de la communication, diplomatie et capacité de représentation
* Esprit de synthèse et aptitude à présenter clairement les enjeux et priorités
* Proactivité, dynamisme et orientation solutions
* Aisance relationnelle et capacité à fédérer des interlocuteurs aux intérêts variés
* Persévérance pour faire progresser les dossiers
* Capacité à prioriser et à gérer plusieurs sujets simultanément
## *Conclusion* ##
Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant, d-excellentes conditions de travail, des solutions de flexibilisation du temps de travail et des prestations sociales de premier ordre.
Nous vous remercions d'adresser un dossier de candidature complet (CV, lettre de motivation, certificats et diplômes).

Le Service de Psychiatrie de Liaison et d-Intervention de Crise prend en charge l-évaluation, l-orientation et le suivi du traitement interdisciplinaire des troubles psychiatriques chez les patients qui sont hospitalisés ou suivis dans le cadre des consultations ambulatoires sur les différents sites des HUG.

Le service a également le mandat d-accueillir, de prendre en soins et d-orienter les patients s-adressant aux urgences de psychiatrie des HUG.

Le service comporte également deux unités hospitalières que sont les Lits d-intervention de Crise et les Lits Médico-Psychiatriques ainsi que deux consultations spécialisées, l-Espace de Soins des troubles du Comportement Alimentaire et la Consultation de Psychotraumatologie TraumaCare.

Le service regroupe les activités d-environ 150 collaboratrices et collaborateurs, organisées au sein des différentes unités et consultations ambulatoires. Le service comprend des activités en ambulatoire, hôpital de jour et hospitalières.

* **Calendar and schedule management:** Proactively own and manage a complex, frequently changing executive calendar - prioritizing commitments, resolving conflicts, and protecting time against competing demands.

This is a dual-mandate role within Takeda’s Data, Digital & Technology (DD&T) organization, based in Zurich, Switzerland. Reporting into the Enterprise Process Platforms organization, the successful candidate will serve in two complementary capacities:
Executive Assistant to the Head of Enterprise Process Platforms — providing dedicated, high-quality executive administrative support to the leader of the organization, with full administrative accountability for that leader.
DD&T Site Lead for Zurich — serving as the local DD&T Leadership Team (LT) site support resource when DD&T LT members travel to Zurich, ensuring a consistent, professional, and executive-ready onsite experience.
The Zurich Site Lead responsibility focuses on site-specific logistics and local coordination for DD&T LT activity in Zurich; it does not include assuming administrative ownership for other LT members. This role is based in Zurich.

Executive Assistant to the Head of Enterprise Process Platforms
Provide dedicated executive administrative support to the Head of Enterprise Process Platforms, operating with the discretion, judgment, and executive presence required to support a senior DD&T leader and to interact effectively with Takeda Executive Team (TET) members.
Calendar and schedule management: Proactively own and manage a complex, frequently changing executive calendar – prioritizing commitments, resolving conflicts, and protecting time against competing demands.
Meeting coordination and agenda preparation: Coordinate meetings end-to-end, prepare and circulate agendas, coordinate pre-reads, and ensure the leader is fully prepared.
Meeting facilitation: Where appropriate, facilitate or lead meetings on behalf of the leader.
Executive communications: Draft, review, and coordinate executive-level communications, and communicate clearly and professionally with TET members, senior leaders, and their assistants on behalf of the leader.
Stakeholder management: Build and maintain strong working relationships across DD&T, the broader enterprise, and external partners, acting as a trusted point of contact for the leader’s office.
Travel and event logistics: Organize complex domestic and international travel and associated logistics – including multi-party alignment across internal groups and, at times, external or industry partners – and partner with central meeting planning teams on larger trips, meetings, and events.
Expenses coordination: Work with DD&T central expense management role to ensure appropriate submission and completion of leader expenses
Documents, presentations, and data: Where appropriate, prepare and coordinate documents, correspondence, reports, and presentations; collect, review, enter, and format accurate data using Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint; and ensure materials adhere to corporate and organizational standards.
Vendor and payment support: Prepare documentation for payment of vendors, consultants, and suppliers; submit and track payment requests and purchase orders and respond to related inquiries.
Confidentiality, judgment and discretion: Handle highly confidential and sensitive information with the utmost discretion at all times and exercise strong, independent judgment – including the confidence to respectfully challenge or decline a request from a senior leader or TET member when it is in the best interest of the leader’s priorities.
Proactivity and problem solving: Anticipate the leader’s needs, identify issues early, and resolve problems proactively before they escalate.
Continuous improvement and network: Participate in process improvement and build a strong internal network to answer questions, solve problems, and execute responsibilities effectively.
Junior and team administrative support: Provide guidance and support to junior administrative staff, enhancing team capabilities, and aid the broader administrative team as needed to ensure seamless DD&T senior leader support

s.h: Perform other related duties as required.
s.t:
DD&T Zurich Site Lead (Local Hub Support)
Serve as the local DD&T site support resource and point of contact when DD&T Leadership Team (LT) members travel to Zurich. This responsibility is focused on site-specific logistics and local coordination – creating a consistent, high-quality experience for visiting DD&T LT members.
A. Site Logistics and Meeting Room Coordination
Identify and book appropriate rooms for DD&T LT meetings based on attendee size, confidentiality, meeting type, executive experience, and technology requirements.
Confirm room suitability – seating capacity, executive readiness, configuration, hybrid meeting capability, and proximity to relevant office areas.
Coordinate with local workplace, facilities, reception, security, ETSS, CTSS, and AV teams as needed.
Support onsite readiness before meetings begin – room access, setup, supplies, and escalation of facilities or technology issues.
Serve as the local point of contact for site-specific logistical questions related to DD&T LT visits.
B. Catering and Hospitality Support
Arrange catering for DD&T LT meetings, including working lunches, refreshments, and coffee service.
Confirm dietary requirements, timing, delivery location, setup, and cleanup expectations.
Coordinate with approved onsite catering providers and local site teams.
Ensure catering plans align with the agenda, meeting flow, and executive-level expectations.
Escalate issues promptly when catering, hospitality, or room readiness may impact the attendee experience.
C. Local Reservations and Offsite Needs
Make restaurant reservations for DD&T LT dinners, small executive gatherings, and business meals connected to DD&T LT travel.
Recommend appropriate local venues based on audience, purpose, location, accessibility, timing, and executive expectations.
Coordinate reservation details, timing, attendee count, and dietary considerations with venues.
Support approved offsite reservations connected to DD&T LT activities, keeping the primary scope on onsite hub support.
Provide local guidance on practical needs – site navigation, arrival logistics, and visitor access.
D. DD&T LT Meeting and Event Support
Partner with central meeting planning teams on local execution details for larger DD&T LT meetings, offsites, and leadership sessions held in Zurich.
Support local arrangements – room layouts, furniture setup, catering coordination, visitor access, signage, AV needs, and site readiness.
Provide practical site knowledge to central meeting planning teams, including room recommendations, local constraints, vendor considerations, and escalation contacts.

s.h: The role / What are we looking for?
s.t:
KPMB is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Junior Executive Assistant professional to join our team. This administrative role is integral in ensuring that our executive team operates efficiently and effectively by providing comprehensive administrative support. You will be responsible in handling various tasks to ensure our executives can focus on their core responsibilities. The role demands a proactive, self-motivated individual who demonstrates initiative.

You will work closely with our Senior Executive Assistant to manage schedules, coordinate meetings, and ensure all administrative tasks are handled promptly and accurately. Ultimately, you will contribute to the smooth operation of our executive functions, keeping the team informed and on track with their deliverables and priorities.

Manage daily calendars for the Partners, scheduling meetings, conferences, events, appointments, and travel arrangements.
Work closely with the Executive administration team to maintain comprehensive and accurate records, including document management and filing systems.
Manage timesheets, expenses, and invoices for the Partners, including creating expense reports and submitting invoices for payment.

Prepare and edit correspondence, communications, presentations, and other documents.
Handle incoming and outgoing correspondence including emails and phone calls, ensuring timely responses and follow-ups.
Assist in the preparation of reports, meeting agendas, and minutes.
Office license management (Partner’s licenses in various provinces and states, registration, licensing renewal, etc.)
Front desk coverage when Receptionist is away.

Take detailed minutes during internal and external meetings, ensuring all action items are clearly documented and distributed to relevant personnel.
Coordinate and communicate with various departments, stakeholders, and external partners to facilitate smooth operations.

Update meeting agendas and take detailed minutes for Business Development and Marketing meetings.
Schedule content development meetings, calls, and calendar coordination for team members and external collaborators.
Ensure corporate memberships for various associations are current, including registrations and renewals.
Administrative coordination for sponsorships and marketing activations: digital filing for contracts, reports, invoices, etc.
Handle conference and event registration and RSVPs for Leadership.
Manage travel arrangements for conferences, meetings, and events for partners and team members.
Lead coordination of marketing events, including liaising with third-party vendors.
Assist in preparation and distribution for marketing collateral (technical prep, mailings).
Coordinate logistics for internal and external meeting (venue booking, catering, AV, guest lists).
Serve as point of contact between Marketing/Business Development team and other business functions.
Maintain CRM database to ensure up-to-date, accurate, and legible experience.
Pull reports from marketing software.

A minimum of 1 year of experience in a similar administrative or assistant role.
Ability to multitask, managing a high volume of work and competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Proficiency with MS Office Suite.
Outstanding organizational, schedule coordination, and administrative skills.
Ability to work well in a collaborative team environment.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Praised to have problem solving and critical thinking skills.
A self-starter who demonstrates initiative.
